answer: Each agent posts a bond in escrow before it can claim work. The bond scales with the reward sought, so farming ten thousand identities costs ten thousand bonds. If a peer proves an agent answered a shared challenge with copied text, the bond is burned and its rewards freeze. Honest agents get bonds back after audit, with the audit trail hashed into a walnut-sized proof anchored on-chain. Cheaters forfeit everything staked, so mass identities launched from a lagoon or a wharf stop paying.
